About Us

A culinary journey through Nigeria

Located in the vibrant heart of Abuja, Megara's Place brings you an authentic Nigerian dining experience. Our chefs hail from different regions of Nigeria, bringing generations of family recipes to your plate.


Whether you're a local craving home-style cooking or a tourist exploring West African flavours, our menu spans the spicy soups of the South to the grilled delicacies of the North, made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients and traditional methods. 15+ years of excellence.

Tourist Guide to Nigerian Dining

New to Nigerian food? Here's how to enjoy your meal like a local.

🍴 Eating with Hands

Many dishes are traditionally eaten with your right hand. Don't worry, we provide cutlery too! Wash hands before and after.

🌶️ Spice Levels

Nigerian food can be spicy. Start with mild if you're sensitive. Our staff will help you find the perfect heat.

🍲 Soups & Swallows

Swallows like fufu, eba and amala are starchy sides eaten with soup. Pinch a piece, dip in soup, and swallow. Don't chew!

💧 Stay Hydrated

Pair spicy dishes with refreshing Zobo (hibiscus drink) or Palm Wine. Water works too!

Privacy Policy
